requirements.quote: 1. Create the directory /home/user/reports if it does not yet exist.
The report file contains exactly 5 lines and 5 tab-separated fields per line.
Each line must have five tab-separated columns with **no trailing white-space**:
Lines 2-5 contain the original ids 1-4, in order, with their filenames and both SHA-256 values copied verbatim from the source files.

check.cmd: diff -q <(paste <(tail -n +2 /home/user/data/primary/data_snapshot_20230914.tsv | cut -f1-3) <(tail -n +2 /home/user/data/backup/data_snapshot_20230914.tsv | cut -f3)) <(tail -n +2 /home/user/reports/verification_report_20230914.tsv | cut -f1-4) >/dev/null && test "$(tail -n +2 /home/user/reports/verification_report_20230914.tsv | cut -f1 | tr '\n' ' ')" = '1 2 3 4 '

requirements.quote: Column 5 correctly indicates “OK” or “MISMATCH” for each row.
/home/user/reports/verification.log exists, has exactly one line, and the numeric counts match the report.

check.cmd: test "$(grep -c '' /home/user/reports/verification.log)" -eq 1 && ok=$(tail -n +2 /home/user/reports/verification_report_20230914.tsv | cut -f5 | grep -cx OK); bad=$(tail -n +2 /home/user/reports/verification_report_20230914.tsv | cut -f5 | grep -cx MISMATCH); grep -qx "Integrity check completed: $ok OK, $bad MISMATCH." /home/user/reports/verification.log

requirements.quote: Finally, remove the `/mnt/volume/falcon` directory tree. We need the space.
